terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using HABOS.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: By accessing or using HABOS ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Service.
s1.p2: HABOS is operated by HABOS AI AS (Org.nr. 936 920 594), a company registered in Norway. These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and HABOS AI AS.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.p1: HABOS is an AI-native business operating system that helps businesses manage their operations, communications, and customer relationships from a single platform. The Service includes:
features: AI-powered email, messaging, and phone communication
Dispatch, job management, and field operations
Marketing, website building, and advertising tools
AI assistants, voice notes, and meeting transcription
Team management, HR, and time tracking

s3.title: 3. Subscriptions & Pricing
s3.p1: HABOS offers subscription plans billed monthly or annually through our website. Pricing details are available on the HABOS website and may change with notice.
rows: For solo founders and very small teams
For growing businesses and field teams
For larger organizations with custom needs
s3.freeTierNote: HABOS also offers a limited free plan for evaluation purposes. Feature availability on the free plan may vary.

autoRenewal.title: Auto-Renewal Terms
items: Payment is charged via Stripe at the start of each billing cycle.
Free trial periods begin at the time of signup. If you do not cancel before the trial ends, your subscription will automatically renew and you will be charged.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscription from your HABOS account settings at any time.

s3.refundNote: See our Refund Policy for information about refunds.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: How refunds work for HABOS subscriptions.

s1.title: Subscription Refunds
s1.p1: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all HABOS subscriptions. If you're not satisfied within the first 30 days, contact us for a full refund.
steps: Email us at hello@habos.ai with your account email and reason for the refund
We will process your request within 3 business days
Refunds are issued to your original payment method via Stripe
After 30 days, remaining time on your subscription is non-refundable but you retain access until the end of your billing period

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal and business data under GDPR.

s1.title: 1. Data Controller
s1.p1: HABOS AI AS is the data controller responsible for your personal data collected through the HABOS platform and website.

s2.title: 2. Data We Collect
accountItems: Email address (for account creation and communication)
Name and business name (for personalization and invoicing)
Payment information (processed by Stripe; we do not store card details)
Phone number (optional, for AI receptionist and SMS features)
usageItems: Platform usage analytics (anonymized, collected with your consent via PostHog, EU-hosted)
contentItems: Emails, messages, and communications sent and received through HABOS
Customer and contact records stored in CRM
Calendar events, bookings, and scheduling data
Voice recordings, transcripts, and meeting notes

s3.title: 3. AI Training Policy
s3.boxTitle: Your Data is NOT Used for AI Training
s3.boxText: We do NOT use your business data, communications, or any personal content to train AI models. Your data remains your property. None of our third-party AI providers use your data sent through HABOS for model training purposes.
s3.p1: When we process your data through third-party AI services, it is:
items: Sent securely via encrypted API connections to the relevant provider
Processed and returned to you in real time
Not retained by any AI provider for training purposes
Subject to our data processing agreements with each sub-processor
Handled under each provider's commercial API terms, which prohibit training on customer data

s4.title: 4. Data Architecture
s4.boxIntro: HABOS employs secure cloud architecture with strict data isolation:
items: Each business account's data is logically isolated from other accounts.
Business data is stored securely in our cloud infrastructure (Supabase, EU-hosted).
You can export or delete your data at any time from your account settings.

s5.title: 5. Third-Party AI Services
s5.boxText: HABOS uses third-party artificial intelligence services to power platform features. Below is a breakdown of what data each provider receives and why.
s5.dataSentHeading: Data we send to AI services:
dataSentItems: Email drafts and communication context for AI-assisted writing
Voice recordings and audio for transcription
Business data context for AI assistant queries
Meeting audio and transcripts for note generation
Marketing copy and creative content for AI suggestions

providers.name: Anthropic, PBC (Claude)
providers.dataReceived: Communications, business context, and text content.
providers.purpose: AI assistant responses, email drafting, content analysis, and business intelligence.

providers.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
providers.dataReceived: Text content, communications, and business data context.
providers.purpose: Text analysis, content generation, and AI feature support.

s5.protectionHeading: How we protect your data with these providers:
protectionItems: All data is transmitted securely via encrypted API connections (TLS/SSL).
We use each provider's commercial API, meaning your data is processed under commercial data processing terms and is not used for AI model training.
Each provider is contractually required to provide the same or equal protection of your personal data as described in this Privacy Policy.
s5.choicesText: AI features are integral to the HABOS platform. If you have concerns about specific data processing, contact us to discuss your options.

s6.title: 6. Sub-Processors & Infrastructure
s6.p1: We use the following third-party services to operate HABOS:
s6.footnote: All sub-processors are contractually required to provide the same or equal protection of your personal data as described in this Privacy Policy.

s7.title: 7. Cookies & Website Tracking
s7.p1: The HABOS website (habos.ai) uses the following technologies:
necessaryItems: Your cookie consent preference (stored in localStorage)
s7.necessaryNote: These do not require consent as they are essential for the website to function.
analyticsItems: PostHog — Used for website analytics. Data is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt). PostHog is only activated after you provide consent via our cookie banner.
Data collected includes: page views, clicks, scroll depth, device type, and referral source.
No data is shared with advertisers or used for ad targeting.
s7.cookieSettingsNote: You can change your tracking preferences at any time via the Cookie Settings link in our website footer.

s8.title: 8. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Article 6)
items: Contract Performance: Processing necessary to provide the HABOS service you requested.
Legitimate Interest: Service improvements and security monitoring (with appropriate safeguards).
Consent: Website analytics via PostHog (manageable via Cookie Settings) and marketing communications (withdrawable at any time).
Legal Obligation: Tax records and compliance with applicable laws.

s9.title: 9. Your Rights (GDPR)
s9.p1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data
Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("Right to be Forgotten")
Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
Restriction: Limit how we process your data
Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time
s9.contactNote: To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@habos.ai. We will respond within 30 days.

s10.title: 10. Data Retention
items: Active accounts: Data retained for the duration of your account
Deleted accounts: Data erased within 30 days of account deletion
Financial records: Retained for 7 years as required by Norwegian law

s11.title: 11. Data Security
s11.p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
items: TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit
AES-256 encryption for data at rest
Regular security audits
Role-based access controls and employee training
